Mrs. Fisher: You already caught a fine amount of bluegills, huh.
Mrs. Fisher: I remember when I was but a young lass. I used to catch them on a hook alone, no bait at all.
Mrs. Fisher: After I got good at fishing, there were weeks I would only eat crappies and bluegills, but after a while grandma just couldn’t take it anymore and broke my rod over her knee.
Mrs. Fisher: She also broke her leg in the process. Menopause is a bitch.
You: Is she ok? 
#mrsfisher.face.angry
Mrs. Fisher: That old bag of bones? No idea. I’m too busy fishing to give a crap.
#mrsfisher.face.normal
